description: Preferences update: the PUT body once confirmed, the non-empty-object rejection, and the response shape. A bare-array body is rejected in both languages now that Python's client raises instead of swapping any non-object body for an empty object. JSON null stays a success in both: Go decodes preferences into a map, where encoding/json leaves a null body alone without erroring.

cases.name: rejects an empty preferences object
cases.expect_error: preferences must be a non-empty object

cases.name: reads a null body as empty preferences
requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This updates profile preferences. Set confirm=true to proceed.
